The author is making a lot of assumptions. A game development studio should be able to take whatever project that comes their way and make it a success. It's not up to Microsoft to generate attention for the project on behalf of the studio. The studio is the one with the product to show off. Microsoft gets some input into the project but it's extremely unlikely that Microsoft handed them a complete design document and sent them off to churn out Microsoft's game without allowing them any input of their own.

The fact that they've apparently had so many different Fable titles in the works at different points in the recent past and I hadn't heard of any of them until news of the Lionhead shutdown today says a lot, and trying to put it all on Microsoft is pretty naive.
